Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer that will be in charge with the development and maintenance of the dynamic systems which comprise the main platform for our games and third-party integration, part of the Responsible Gaming department - Compliance & Player Protection.
 What you will do: 
 • Framework Development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks from scratch using .NET, Selenium, and Playwright.
 • Test Creation & Execution: Write clean, reliable, and reusable automated test scripts for web applications (UI and API).
 • Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects to resolution using tools like Jira, providing detailed reports and replication steps to the development team.
 • Strategy & Planning: Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to analyze requirements, define test strategies, and determine the optimal mix of manual and automated testing.
 • Maintenance: Continuously update and refactor existing automation scripts to accommodate application changes and reduce flakiness.
 What you must have: 
 • Experience: [5+] years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance with a heavy focus on test automation.
 Automation Tools:
 • Proven experience building UI automation frameworks with Selenium WebDriver and .NET/C#
 • Hands-on experience with modern testing tools like Playwright for fast, reliable end-to-end testing.
 • Test Runners/Frameworks: Experience with NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest. (Experience with BDD frameworks like SpecFlow is a plus).
 • API Testing: Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience automating API tests (using tools like RestSharp, Postman, or HTTPClient).
 • Agile Mindset: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
 What's in it for you: 
 • Extended compensation and benefits package
 • Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
 • A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
 • Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
 • Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
 • Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
 SII Romania is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity, equality and inclusion within our workforce and working environment. For this purpose, we encourage all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, race ethnicity, beliefs, marital status, disability or other characteristics to send us their applications.
